kquant.quality_note: the text weights of both packs (15.13 GB each); the repos also carry the vision tower, which neither run exercised
kquant.scored_with: mlx-lm 0.32.2 on a Modal H100 (mlx with CUDA), on the text weights
kquant.text_caveat: Quality was measured on text workloads; the vision tower is included but was not evaluated.
kquant.min_kapitsa: This needs Kapitsa 0.2.34 or later (or a build from main until 0.2.34 is out).
kquant.credits: The MTP head (`mtp.safetensors`) and `mtplx_runtime.json` are from [Youssofal/Qwen3.8-27B-MTPLX-Optimized-Speed](https://huggingface.co/Youssofal/Qwen3.8-27B-MTPLX-Optimized-Speed) at `1d5087d2` (MTPLX, apache-2.0), unchanged. Tokenizer and chat template as in [Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B). Thanks to Youssofal.
kquant.tokenizer_note: this repo ships the tokenizer of Qwen3.8-27B; every run here used the catalog pack's tokenizer, whose ids are identical on English, code, math, CJK, emoji and RTL text; Devanagari and Thai were not measured
kquant.speed_caveat: Two of the three KQuant legs ran before `mtplx_runtime.json` was in the pack directory; the third leg has it, as this repo ships it.
kquant.catalog_pinned_note: false on main until the opt-in catalog variant 27b:kquant lands (a separate Kapitsa PR); the published model card is generated with true so its run line is correct on the day the repo goes public
kquant.engine_note: the DFlash2 drafter [incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2](https://huggingface.co/incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2) at `015e7956` for both packs; speeds with another drafter will differ
